messages:
Alex: FYI escalating a Priority support issue to CS — trial account ClearPath hitting embed 502s since ~02:00 PST. Support restarted workers but error persists. Need CS to prep comms and enablement touch.
Maya: Ack — can you paste the error and the last successful timestamp? sounds like potential model or infra fallback.
Alex: Last successful request 01:58. Failing at 02:03. Sample log:```ERROR embed-service: upstream 502 for /v1/embeddings model=ada-060; trace_id=tx-9ab3; err="kv cache miss + timeout"```
Alex: Repro steps: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeds -d '{"model":"ada-060","input":"test"}' -> 502 consistently from prod pool A. We've opened infra ticket INF-1142.
oncall-bot: [alert] Alert: embed-service 5xx spike (group: prod-pool-A) — 87 errors in last 5m.
Maya: Thanks. Sam, can you join? we should coordinate an enablement-runbook and a short comm plan for the customer. cc @Devon for renewal risk context — ClearPath is a high-touch trial (trial ends in 5 days).
Sam: On it. Quick triage Qs: did support already try increasing instance_count or switching routing to pool-B? If not, propose temporary routing + scheduled sync with customer.
Alex: We tried restart and a lane failover command, not pool switch. We can do pool-B switch but need CS ok to notify customer about planned failover.
Devon: This is sensitive given renewal timeline. If fix > 6h, flag as renewal-risk and propose committed warm intro with solutions engineer. Also recommend offering a 1-week free dedication window if SLA impacted.
Maya: Proposed comms plan (short): 1) Immediate acknowledgement within 30m — explain we see 502s and are investigating. 2) Within 1h — update w/ mitigation (pool switch + ETA). 3) Post-fix — detailed RCA + remediation + offer enablement session. Draft message I can send: "We’re investigating a transient error affecting embeddings for your trial; we’ve queued a mitigation and will update within the hour. Sorry for the disruption."
Sam: Operational playbook actions: - temp route to pool-B (ops) - monitor token latency and error rate on dashboard (link: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/prod-pool-A) - increase KV cache TTL to 30s for trial tenant - enable verbose logs for 1h for traces with trace_id header
Alex: I can do the pool-B switch now, then monitor. Will patch CURL repro with a header to include trace_id.
Maya: Can someone draft the customer acknowledgement? Alex, if you post the brief I’ll send from CS. Also schedule a 30-min sync with customer + SE if we need deep-dive. Time suggestion: 14:30 PST (in 45m).
Alex: Draft: "Hi team — we’re aware of intermittent 502s on embeddings; we’re routing you to an alternate capacity and will confirm when traffic is stable. Expect next update within 1 hour. —Alex, Support" :thumbsup:
Maya: I cleaned and shorted it: "Hi — we’re aware of intermittent 502s on embeddings for your trial. We’re routing your requests to alternate capacity now and will confirm when stable. We’ll follow with an RCA and an optional enablement call. —Maya, Customer Success"
Sam: After pool switch, ops should verify 200/success for 10 consecutive samples and keep verbose traces for 30m. If errors persist escalate to runtime eng.
Alex: Pool-B switch executed at 2912345690. Initial verification: 18/20 requests ok, 2 transient 502s within 2m. Monitoring.
oncall-bot: [incident-update] INF-1142 status -> mitigation applied (route-switch) at 2912345690
Devon: Good. Maya, please send the acknowledgement and mark account as "renewal-watch" in CRM. Also create follow-up play: postmortem + offer 1:1 enablement session pre-renewal.
Maya: Sent acknowledgement to ClearPath at 2912345700. Copy of message posted to thread.
Maya: Action items assigned: Alex (monitor & escalate infra if >5% errors), Sam (verify logs & KV TTL change), Devon (renewal play & CRM tag), Maya (customer comm + schedule 30-min enablement call).
Maya: I'll run the enablement template focused on embed best practices and cost/latency tuning; will include suggested prompt/size limits and quantization options.
Alex: Monitoring shows error rate down to 0.8% over last 10m; will keep watching and will escalate if it climbs.
Sam: Noted. If ClearPath accepts the enablement call, propose SE + CS + Support on the line, share a short agenda: 1) what happened 2) best practices 3) next steps & Qs.
Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with meeting invite and RCA draft. Marking this thread resolved when error <0.5% for 30m. :eyes:
